definitions.full: H3534. kebesh כֶּ֫בֶשׁ noun [masculine] footstool (late) (Late Hebrew id., step, stair ; Aramaic כִּבְשָׁא , etc., a rude seat (rare)) — ׳כ הַזָּהָב 2Chr 9:18 (of Solomon's throne).

occurrences.englishText: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.
